description_zh: 当前高度低于 RTL_ALT 时持续爬升，直到达到该高度。
description_en: If the current altitude is less than RTL_ALT, then altitude must be increased until the altitude is greater or equal to RTL_ALT.

description_zh: 达到返航高度且尚未到家时，保持高度并移动到返航参考位置。
description_en: If the current altitude is greater or equal to RTL_ALT, current flight mode is RTL, and the current vehicle is not at home position, then the vehicle must move to the home position while maintaining the current altitude.
paper_formula_transcription: G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_ALT) & (Pos_t != home_position)) -> ((Pos_t-1 != Pos_t) & (ALT_t-1 = ALT_t)))
binding_formula_interpretation: G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_ALT) & (Pos_t != home_position)) -> ((Pos_t-1 != Pos_t) & (ALT_t-1 = ALT_t)))

description_zh: 达到返航高度并到达返航参考位置后进入着陆模式。
description_en: If current altitude is greater or equal to RTL_ALT and current position is the same as home position, then flight mode must be LAND.

description_zh: 着陆模式触地后锁定电机。
description_en: If current flight mode is LAND and the vehicle touches the ground, then the vehicle must disarm motors.

description_zh: 满足横滚、油门、高度和前一模式条件时才允许进入翻滚模式。
description_en: If and only if roll is less than 45 degree, throttle is greater or equal to 1,500, altitude is more than 10 meters, and the current flight mode is one of ACRO and ALT_HOLD, then the flight mode can be changed to FLIP.

description_zh: 翻滚模式特定横滚角区间内向右以每秒 400 度滚转。
description_en: If the current flight mode is FLIP and roll is between -90 and 45 degree, then rolling right at 400 degree per second.

description_zh: 完成翻滚阶段后在未知 k 时间内恢复原始姿态。
description_en: After the vehicle finishes A.FLIP2, the vehicle must recover the original attitude (i.e., roll, pitch, and yaw) within k seconds.
paper_formula_transcription: G((Mode_t = FLIP3) -> ((Roll_t = F_[0,k] Roll_original) & (Pitch_t = F_[0,k] Pitch_original) & (Yaw_t = F_[0,k] Yaw_original)))
binding_formula_interpretation: G((Mode_t = FLIP3) -> ((Roll_t = F_[0,k] Roll_original) & (Pitch_t = F_[0,k] Pitch_original) & (Yaw_t = F_[0,k] Yaw_original)))

description_zh: 应在 2.5 秒内完成翻滚并恢复原飞行模式。
description_en: The vehicle should complete the rolling (A.FLIP2) within 2.5 seconds and must return to the original flight mode.

description_zh: 高度来源为气压计时采用气压计高度而非 GPS 高度。
description_en: If the altitude source is the barometer, the vehicle must follow the altitude computed by this source, rather than the GPS.

description_zh: 定高模式中油门位于中值时保持高度。
description_en: If the throttle stick is in the middle (i.e., 1,500) the vehicle must maintain the current altitude.

description_zh: 绕圈模式中俯仰杆向上使半径持续减小到零。
description_en: Pitch stick up must reduce the radius until it reaches zero.

description_zh: 绕圈模式中俯仰杆向下使半径增加。
description_en: Pitch stick down must increase the radius.

description_zh: 顺时针绕圈时横滚杆向右使速度增加。
description_en: Roll stick right (think clockwise) must increase the speed while moving clockwise.

description_zh: 逆时针绕圈时横滚杆向右使速度减小。
description_en: Roll stick right (think clockwise) must decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise.

description_zh: 逆时针绕圈时横滚杆向左使速度增加。
description_en: Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) must increase the speed while moving counterclockwise.

description_zh: 顺时针绕圈时横滚杆向左使速度减小。
description_en: Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) must decrease the speed while moving clockwise.

description_zh: 绕圈模式忽略横滚、俯仰、偏航控制，但允许油门改变高度。
description_en: The users do not have any control over the roll, pitch, and yaw but can change the altitude with the throttle stick.

description_zh: 着陆模式高于 10 米时按 LAND_SPEED_HIGH 参数下降。
description_en: Above 10 meters the vehicle must descend at the rate specified in the LAND_SPEED_HIGH parameter.

description_zh: 着陆模式低于 10 米时按 LAND_SPEED 参数下降。
description_en: Below 10 meters the vehicle must descend at the rate specified in the LAND_SPEED parameter.

description_zh: 自动模式忽略横滚、俯仰和油门输入，但允许偏航覆盖。
description_en: The pilot's roll, pitch and throttle inputs must be ignored but the yaw can be overridden with the yaw stick.

description_zh: 制动模式中应在未知 k 时间内停止。
description_en: When the vehicle is in BRAKE mode, it must stop within k seconds.

description_zh: 漂移模式中 GPS 丢失后按 FS_EKF_ACTION 进入着陆或定高模式。
description_en: If the vehicle loses GPS signals in flight while in DRIFT mode, the vehicle must either LAND or enter ALT_HOLD mode based on FS_EKF_ACTION parameter.

description_zh: 定点盘旋模式保持位置、航向和高度。
description_en: The vehicle must maintain a constant location, heading, and altitude.

description_zh: 引导模式没有剩余航点时保持位置、航向和高度。
description_en: If there is no more way point, the vehicle must stay at the same location, heading, and altitude.
paper_formula_transcription: G(((Mode_t = GUIDED) & (Waypoint = empty)) -> ((Pos_t = Pos_t-1) & (Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1) & (ALT_t = ALT_t-1)))
binding_formula_interpretation: G(((Mode_t = GUIDED) & (Waypoint = empty)) -> ((Pos_t = Pos_t-1) & (Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1) & (ALT_t = ALT_t-1)))

description_zh: 运动模式按 PILOT_SPEED_UP 参数爬升。
description_en: In SPORT mode, the vehicle must climb as indicated by the PILOT_SPEED_UP parameter.

description_zh: 已解锁的特技模式中油门低于阈值时立即锁定。
description_en: If and only if the vehicle is armed in ACRO mode and the throttle input is less than the minimum (FS_THR_VALUE parameter), the vehicle must immediately disarm.

description_zh: 油门低于 FS_THR_VALUE 时开启遥控故障保护。
description_en: If the throttle input is less than FS_THR_VALUE parameter, it must change the current mode to the RC fail-safe mode.

description_zh: 释放降落伞要求电机已解锁、模式允许、没有爬升且高于最低开伞高度。
description_en: Deploying a parachute requires following conditions: motors armed, mode not FLIP or ACRO, not climbing, and altitude above CHUTE_ALT_MIN.
paper_formula_transcription: G((Parachute = on) -> ((Armed = true) & (Mode_t notin FLIP/ACRO) & (ALT_t <= ALT_t-1) & (ALT_t > CHUTE_ALT_MIN)))
binding_formula_interpretation: G((Parachute = on) -> ((Armed = true) & (Mode_t notin FLIP/ACRO) & (ALT_t <= ALT_t-1) & (ALT_t > CHUTE_ALT_MIN)))

description_zh: 检测到的 GPS 卫星少于四颗时触发 GPS 故障保护。
description_en: When the number of detected GPS satellites is less than four, the vehicle must trigger the GPS fail-safe mode.

description_zh: GPS 故障保护触发且气压计可用时改用气压计高度来源。
description_en: When the GPS fail-safe mode is triggered and there is a secondary altitude sensor, the vehicle must change the current primary altitude source to the secondary sensor.

description_zh: 当前高度低于 RTL_RETURN_ALT 时持续爬升，直到达到该高度。
description_en: If the current altitude is less than RTL_RETURN_ALT, then altitude must be increased until the altitude is greater or equal to RTL_RETURN_ALT.

description_zh: 达到 PX4 返航高度且尚未到家时保持高度并移动到家。
description_en: If the current altitude is greater or equal to RTL_RETURN_ALT, current flight mode is RTL, and the current vehicle is not home position, then the vehicle must move to the home position while maintaining the current altitude.
paper_formula_transcription: G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_RETURN_ALT) & (Pos_t != home_position)) -> ((Pos_t-1 != Pos_t) & (ALT_t-1 = ALT_t)))
binding_formula_interpretation: G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_RETURN_ALT) & (Pos_t != home_position)) -> ((Pos_t-1 != Pos_t) & (ALT_t-1 = ALT_t)))

description_zh: 达到返航高度并到家后进入着陆模式。
description_en: If current altitude is greater or equal to RTL_RETURN_ALT and current position is the same as home position, then flight mode must be LAND.

description_zh: RTL_LAND_DELAY 为负一时在 RTL_DESCEND_ALT 高度盘旋。
description_en: If RTL_LAND_DELAY parameter has -1, the vehicle must hover at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

description_zh: 与 A.RTL4 相同：着陆触地后锁定电机。
description_en: It is the same as A.RTL4.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.RTL4.

description_zh: 继承 A.CIRCLE1，并把绕圈模式解释为 PX4 ORBIT。
description_en: It is the same as A.CIRCLE1.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.CIRCLE1.

description_zh: 继承 A.CIRCLE2，并把绕圈模式解释为 PX4 ORBIT。
description_en: It is the same as A.CIRCLE2.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.CIRCLE2.

description_zh: 继承 A.CIRCLE3，并把绕圈模式解释为 PX4 ORBIT。
description_en: It is the same as A.CIRCLE3.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.CIRCLE3.

description_zh: 继承 A.CIRCLE4，并把绕圈模式解释为 PX4 ORBIT。
description_en: It is the same as A.CIRCLE4.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.CIRCLE4.

description_zh: 绕点飞行最大半径为 100 米。
description_en: The maximum radius must be 100 meters.

description_zh: 绕点飞行最大加速度限制为每平方秒 2 米。
description_en: The maximum acceleration must be limited to 2m/s^2.

description_zh: 下降速度等于 MPC_LAND_SPEED 参数。
description_en: Descending speed must be the same as MPC_LAND_SPEED parameter.

description_zh: 继承 A.ALT_HOLD2，并把模式解释为 PX4 ALTITUDE。
description_en: It is the same as A.ALT_HOLD2.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.ALT_HOLD2.

description_zh: 位置控制模式保持位置不变。
description_en: The vehicle must maintain a constant position.

description_zh: 继承 A.LOITER1，并把模式解释为 PX4 HOLD。
description_en: It is the same as A.LOITER1.
paper_formula_transcription: It is the same as A.LOITER1.

description_zh: 最小盘旋高度启用且当前高度低于它时爬升到该高度。
description_en: If MIS_LTRMIN_ALT is not -1 and current altitude is less than the parameter value, then the vehicle must ascend to this altitude.

description_zh: 执行起飞命令时目标高度应等于 MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT。
description_en: When the vehicle conducts a taking off command, the target altitude must be the MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT parameter value.

description_zh: 执行起飞命令时上升速度应等于 MPC_TKO_SPEED。
description_en: When the vehicle conducts a taking off command, the speed of ascent must be the MPC_TKO_SPEED parameter value.

description_zh: 检测到 GPS 丢失后，在 COM_POS_FS_DELAY 加调度余量内触发故障保护。
description_en: If time exceeds COM_POS_FS_DELAY seconds after GPS loss is detected, the GPS fail-safe must be triggered.

description_zh: GPS 故障保护触发且遥控可用时进入高度模式。
description_en: If the GPS fail-safe is triggered and a remote controller is available, the flight mode must be changed to ALTITUDE mode.

description_zh: GPS 故障保护触发且遥控不可用时进入着陆模式。
description_en: If the GPS fail-safe is triggered and a remote controller is not available, the flight mode must be changed to LAND mode.
